title: 📕The college girl I kept said she was shy—I caught her with another guy. Fine, her roomie’s my type
description:
📖 Story Synopsis:
I was raising a beautiful college girl, but she insisted on playing hard to get.
 She said relationships should develop slowly.
I thought she was just young and shy.
Until I saw her hanging all over another man—
Oh, so it wasn’t shyness.
 She was just afraid of getting caught juggling guys.
Fine. I’ll switch targets.
 Her roommate is prettier than her anyway.”

title: 📕Once I learned the plot, I let my wife see her first love—even told her to dress sexier. She froze!
description:
📖 Story Synopsis:
By the time I awakened, the story hadn't even made it out of the tutorial stage.
The ML was still a delivery guy.
He hadn't met the female lead yet.
I was a delivery guy too.
And I hadn't reunited with my billionaire father yet.
After six months of delivering takeout, I suddenly awakened.
That's when I realized I was living inside a sweet romance novel.
And my role?
The vicious second ML.
Tomorrow, I would reunite with my wealthy father.
After that, following the grand tradition of rich families, I'd enter an arranged marriage with a wealthy heiress I had zero feelings for.
Then I'd get cheated on.
Meanwhile, the ML would marry the beautiful, rich female lead and reach the pinnacle of life.
Every day, he'd flaunt their relationship right in front of me until I completely lost it.
I'd spend years trying every dirty trick imaginable to break them up.
In the end, I'd get thrown in jail.
And the ML and female lead would happily welcome a pair of twins.
For fuck's sake...
What kind of sadistic author wrote this garbage?
I'm a rich second-generation heir with all the money and free time in the world.
Why the hell would I give up a life of luxury just to sabotage the leads?
According to the plot, my father would take me back into the family.
Then I'd marry the daughter of the Liu family and smoothly land a cushy position at Liu Group.
But for the rest of the story?
I chose a different path.
She could do her thing.
I'd do mine.
And we'd each enjoy our lives.
When Willow Liu said she was going to meet her crush, I even suggested she wear something a little more revealing.
I told her,
"Mr Ito likes bold girls. Trust me. Wear that black lace camisole."

title: 📕I charged my wife every time her fl taunted me—then she panicked when our daughter and I moved on!
description:
📖 Story Synopsis:
My wife’s first love—the man she had always put on a pedestal—came back from overseas.
And she wanted our daughter and me to move out so he could move in.
I used to think ridiculous things like this only happened in novels.
Now I’ve realized that apparently, the whole damn world is one giant novel.
First, my wife started blatantly favoring him. Then she began missing more and more of the important moments in our daughter’s life.
I seriously wondered if the man had put some kind of spell on her.
But I honestly couldn’t care less.
Because every time that pretentious homewrecker tried to provoke me, I used it as an excuse to get another fat payout from my wife.
Why waste my energy obsessing over love and jealousy when I could keep my bank account nice and full?
When my daughter and I happily took her money and traveled around the world, my wife finally couldn’t take it anymore.
“Do you two seriously not care how I’m doing back home?”
I told her that kind of concern was an add-on service.
And add-ons cost extra.

title: 📕My wife brought her sick first love home and told me not to worry—so I took in my longtime crush!
description:
📖 Story Synopsis:
My wife brought her sick ex-boyfriend back home,
 her eyes red as she said she wanted to take care of him.
My worldview completely shattered.
 I questioned if her brain had been kicked by a donkey.
 Was she really cheating so blatantly now?
Yet she accused me of being filthy!
 She said that people with dirty hearts see everything as dirty.
 She just wanted to make up for the regrets of the past.
Fury burned inside me as I slammed the door and left.
 But unexpectedly, the very next second,
 a slender figure blocked my path.
“Geo,
 long time no see.”
I looked up in disbelief.
 There she was—
 Willow, the goddess I had secretly loved for years.
At this moment, she looked weak,
 leaning on a cane, her body trembling slightly,
 so fragile that it stirred pity at first glance.
My eyes instantly turned red.
At that moment,
 I suddenly understood my wife.
I couldn’t help but grab the woman’s hand and say,
 “Come home with me. I’ll take care of you.”

title: 📕My fiancée sent a pregnancy test, then unsent it. When she came back for me, I’d married someone!
description:
📖 Story Synopsis:
What does it feel like when your fiancée, who has been abroad for three months, sends you a pregnancy test report saying she is two months pregnant?
Three months after my fiancée went abroad, she sent me a message.
It read:
“Honey, you’re going to be a dad!”
Below it was an ultrasound report.
I was over the moon.
I never thought I was actually going to be a father.
But when I opened the image, I saw the words printed clearly on the report:
Seven weeks pregnant.
I was happily counting the days on my fingers when the message was suddenly recalled.
Then a new message popped up.
My fiancée wrote:
“Sorry. Sent it to the wrong person.”
I froze in front of the screen.
The smile on my face slowly stiffened.
So…
Was I the one who was going to be a dad?

title: 📕After we reconciled, I stopped chasing her. She proposed—my revenge began at city hall
description:
📖 Story Synopsis:
I accompanied my cousin Renata, who was six months pregnant, to the hospital for a prenatal checkup. 
Her husband was away on business most of the year, and she hated how anxious her mother got every time she came to the hospital, so she simply roped me into coming along.
“This little rascal kicked me all night. I wonder who the baby takes after.”
Renata supported her lower back, frowning slightly as she complained nonstop.
I was about to respond when something suddenly caught my eye.
By the window in the infusion area, Miranda sat sideways, her head lowered as she spoke to the person beside her.
It had been five years. 
Her hair was a little shorter now, tucked neatly behind her ears.
She wore a beige knit cardigan and still looked as gentle as ever.
Beside her was Cole.
The man who had relentlessly haunted our relationship back when Miranda and I were together.
His head rested against her shoulder, his eyes closed and his face pale.
Miranda held a thermos in her hands and spoke softly to him, her expression attentive.
My fingers clenched sharply, my nails digging deep into my palm.
“Alonso?”
Renata nudged my arm.
“What are you staring at? They called our number.”
I abruptly came back to my senses. My throat felt dry, and an almost imperceptible bitterness crept into my voice.
“Nothing.”
Renata followed my gaze and noticed Miranda as well. A thoughtful look appeared in her eyes.
But my mind kept replaying the scene I had just witnessed.
Cole leaning against Miranda’s shoulder, while she lowered her head and tended to him with concern.
Five years had passed, yet they were still like this.
No. Perhaps they were even closer than before.

title: 📕My ex failed to marry rich, saw me on TV and wanted me back—then the next shot made her break down!
description:
📖 Story Synopsis:
What kind of sins did I commit in my past life
to end up marrying an idiot like Sophia in this one?
Just last week,
Sophia proudly told me
that she had become her boss Makoto’s mistress
and was about to successfully replace his wife. 
Apparently, when Makoto’s wife showed up to confront them,
not only did he protect Sophia in front of everyone at the company,
he immediately asked his wife for a divorce.
Sophia looked absolutely lovestruck as she told me about it,
as if she were living out some cheesy
“domineering CEO falls in love with me” fantasy.
If I didn’t know any better,
I would have thought she wanted me to start shipping the two of them.
But then,
the idiot happily went along with Makoto
to provoke his wife right to her face.
His wife slapped Sophia.
Sophia had barely raised her hand to hit back
when Makoto suddenly stepped in like some domineering husband
and slapped Sophia too.
He snapped,
“She’s my wife! How dare you try to hit her!”
Sophia was completely dumbfounded.
It took her a long moment to finally figure out what was going on.
So the married couple had just been having a fight
and were using her to vent their frustration!
She was nothing more than a prop
in their little marital love game!

title: 📕She married him, then realized she loved me. I smiled and told her why I chased her—she broke!
description:
📖 Story Synopsis:
At my goddess Willow’s wedding,
everyone was cheering and celebrating.
Everyone except me.
I was bawling my eyes out like I was at a damn funeral!
Snot was practically stretching three thousand feet from my nose!
The guests were deeply moved by the sight.
They said,
“A real man doesn’t shed tears easily. He only cries when the pain cuts too deep.”
Pain, my ass!
I was crying because I was happy!
Only God knew what I’d been through during those three years of being Willow’s simp and personal errand boy!
Three whole years of acting, and the show was finally over!
I, George, was free!
But never in a million years did I expect that the very next day after the wedding, my goddess would contact me again.
She texted,
“After going around in circles, I finally realized that the person who loved me most was you all along.”
Excuse me?
My mission was already complete!
You’re not draining another cent out of me!
I immediately replied,
“This simp has officially logged off. Don’t start!”
But after Willow learned the truth, she actually broke down and accused me through heart-wrenching sobs,
“Three years!
You lied to me for three whole years!
George, how could you play with my feelings like this?!”

title: 📕My GF left with another guy, said her flight was delayed—then her Uber arrived: me, driving her car
description:
📖 Story Synopsis:
While driving a Rolls-Royce to the airport to pick up Uber passengers,
 I unexpectedly saw my girlfriend, Willow, getting off a flight with another man.
Before I could react,
 I received a text from her.
My flight’s been delayed.
 I probably won’t make it back tonight.
 No need to pick me up.
 I’ll take an Uber home myself!
The next second,
 the spare phone mounted on my dashboard beeped twice.
An automated voice immediately announced:
“Uber has automatically accepted a ride for you! Please pick up the passenger whose number ends in 0028 and drive them from the airport to the Moon Bay residential complex. The route has been updated. Please follow the navigation.”
I pulled the car over,
 and the automatic door swung open.
I called out to Willow,
“Number ending in 0028? 
 Hop in! I’ll help you two with your luggage!”

title: 📕Her new admirer warned me not to hurt my childhood sweetheart. I laughed—hurt her? She’s insane!
description:
📖 Story Synopsis:
A sweet, devoted guy had suddenly appeared by my childhood sweetheart Willow’s side, constantly showering her with care and attention. 
Out of the goodness of my heart, I warned him, “Buddy, Willow is a psycho. Simping for her won’t end well.”
To my surprise, the guy practically radiated the dazzling light of righteousness as he stepped in front of Willow protectively.
“I know exactly what kind of person you are,” he declared. “You’re trying to tear a girl down and manipulate her by destroying her self-esteem. As long as I’m here, I won’t let you slander her like this!”
Then he gazed tenderly at Willow.
“Willow, you’re a wonderful person! Don’t let him get inside your head!”
I couldn’t help rubbing my forehead.
“What are you, some patron saint who escaped from Notre-Dame? Even Willow herself wouldn’t believe she’s a good person.”
The guy glared at me furiously before grabbing Willow and storming off.
A second later, Willow looked back from around the corner.
She pressed one finger to her lips and gave me a provocative wink.
Fucking psycho.

title: 📕My GF exploded over dinner with another woman. I said, “I didn’t cheat”—her own words shut her up!
description:
📖 Story Synopsis:
The door suddenly flew open, and Judy stormed in like a madwoman.
“Alex, who did you have dinner with tonight?”
Alex looked at her calmly. “Fiona. My assistant. You know her too.”
“You…” Judy’s voice shot up several octaves. “That bitch is obviously after you, and you still went to dinner alone with her?”
“No, it was just work.” Alex gave her an innocent look. “You need to trust me. You’re the only woman I consider my girlfriend. As long as I’m not cheating on you, what are you worried about? And whatever she thinks about me is her problem. What does it have to do with me?”
The room suddenly fell silent.
Judy swallowed with difficulty, as though every word she wanted to say had gotten stuck in her throat.
Because those were the exact same words she had once used to explain herself to Alex.
Now that the boomerang had come flying back at her, she finally understood just how much it hurt.

title: 📕She stayed out till 3 AM; I canceled the venue, wedding, and honeymoon—she rushed home like crazy!
description:
📖 Story Synopsis:
My fiancée said she was going out with her best friend to clear her head, and didn’t come back by three in the morning.
 I didn’t call. I didn’t text. I didn’t even roll over.
At dawn, I called the sales office and canceled the wedding apartment I had booked for half a year—a ten-million-priced property.
 I also casually canceled the wedding planner, the hotel, and the honeymoon flights.
Everything was settled by nine thirty.
There was still half an hour before the hotpot restaurant opened, so I decided to get a haircut first.
When she rushed back after receiving the refund notifications, the hotpot broth was already almost reduced to nothing.

title: 📕My rich ex-wife brought our son to take me back—only to find me living my best life without them!
description:
📖 Story Synopsis:
My wife, Willow, and I grew up together in an orphanage.
We went from strangers to friends, then lovers, and eventually became husband and wife and had a child together.
We were each other’s only family and sole source of support.
But never in my wildest dreams did I imagine that shortly after giving birth, Willow would be found by her wealthy biological parents and brought back into the Liu family.
Naturally, they looked down on me.
Not only did they refuse to accept me, but they also wanted Willow to divorce me and marry someone else—preferably into the Ito family.
Yet despite the immense pressure from her family, Willow Liu adamantly refused to give in. She would rather die than divorce me.
In the end, both sides reached a compromise.
Our son took the Liu surname, Willow became the Liu family’s sole heiress, and I became the husband who had married into her wealthy family.
But years later, I placed a divorce agreement in front of Willow.
When she asked me why, I calmly set down my fork and said,
“Because the food has gone cold, and I can’t stomach it anymore.”

title: 📕I left her with nothing; she thought that was revenge—until her first love ditched her for this!
description:
📖 Story Synopsis:
After my wife went through a breakup, she cried alone every day until late into the night.
I chose to turn a deaf ear, half blind and half deaf, just hoping to get through it smoothly!
Unexpectedly, the next day, she actually accused me of not caring about her.
Sophia pointed at my nose and cursed me:
“I married you only to realize I was blind!”
“I’m heartbroken here and you don’t even bother to comfort me!”
Hearing this, I felt deeply ashamed.
So I called all eight of my girlfriends I was secretly keeping outside and brought them home.
Let them take turns comforting her.
After all, women understand women better.
And there were so many of them.
But what I never expected was—
she completely broke down emotionally.

description:
📖 Story Synopsis:
On my birthday, I received a loving transfer of 1314 from my girlfriend.
I was touched. I really was.
Until I saw her apprentice’s social media post—a screenshot of a 131,400 transfer.
Caption: My mentor says she’ll love me forever.
I silently pulled out my calculator.
One hundred thirty-one thousand four hundred divided by one thousand three hundred fourteen equals one hundred. 
Apparently, in her heart, I was worth one-hundredth of her apprentice.
Math doesn’t lie.
That night, I packed my things and left for another city.
I had never cared about the money.
But once you see where you rank in someone’s heart, you can’t pretend you didn’t.

title: 📕I called my GF my first love. The campus queen snapped—then found she'd erased all proof we dated!
description:
📖 Story Synopsis:
I went to great lengths to win over Willow, the prettiest girl at school.
But after we got together, she treated me coldly.
She never made our relationship public, and whenever she posted online, she only uploaded pictures of herself.
At first, I thought she was simply reserved.
Until one day, I overheard her friend asking her,
“Willow, why does that old classmate of yours keep coming to see you? Don’t tell me you two are dating.”
“Isn’t Makoto, the hottest guy at school, pursuing you? I thought you two were the couple.”
Willow merely replied in an indifferent tone,
“We’re not dating.”
Maria clutched her chest and said,
“You scared me to death! I knew someone as gorgeous as my friend wouldn’t date some four-eyes.”
Willow didn’t correct her.
So I chose a time and asked Willow to meet me.
Then I said to her seriously,
“Willow, could you… pretend we were never together?”
Willow frowned and snapped impatiently,
“George, what the hell has gotten into you?”
I replied,
“No, I’m serious. I’m begging you.”
“If my buddies found out I’d dated an idiot like you, they’d laugh themselves to death.”
“It would be way too embarrassing.”

description:
Name: She Ditched My Birthday For Her Art Crush

--Summary--
Callahan and Seraphina were inseparable childhood sweethearts whose lifelong bond led everyone to believe they were destined for a happily-ever-after. However, college life alters their dynamic when Bramwell, a charming art major with shared creative passions, maneuvers his way into Seraphina's world. Through calculated manipulation and victim-playing, Bramwell orchestrates conflicts that erode Seraphina’s trust in Callahan. The turning point arrives on Callahan’s birthday: while he waits in the pouring rain with a bouquet of roses prepared for a confession, Seraphina chooses to attend Bramwell’s conflicting birthday gathering instead. Heartbroken and exhausted, Callahan finally gives up his one-sided devotion, distributes the confession roses to his friends, and emotionally withdraws behind polite, distant boundaries. As Seraphina belatedly senses his retreat and spiraling anxiety sets in over the fading warmth she took for granted, Callahan retreats to his safe haven—the campus Literature Club. There, greeting the poised and elegant Senior Genevieve, Callahan steps into an uncertain yet liberating new chapter, leaving the lingering remnants of their shared past open to whatever consequences Seraphina's delayed realization may bring.

title: I Let My In-Laws Kick Me Out For Her Childhood Sweetheart, Unaware I Have $300M! - Hein Recap
description:
Name: I Let My In-Laws Kick Me Out For Her Childhood Sweetheart, Unaware I Have $300M!

--Summary--
Ronan spent three years in a sham contract marriage with corporate executive Seraphina Vance, quietly enduring mistreatment and domestic drudgery from his aloof wife, dismissive mother-in-law Beatrice, and demanding sister-in-law Piper. Unbeknownst to them, Ronan leveraged his finance expertise to secretly invest his modest living allowance, eventually growing a personal fortune of 300 million. Because his contract stipulated that Seraphina had to initiate the split for him to gain unconditional freedom, Ronan orchestrated the return of Alistair, her arrogant childhood sweetheart. The Vance family immediately fell for Alistair's facade and Seraphina decisively demanded a divorce, unwittingly giving Ronan the exact exit he had schemed for. He signed the papers with concealed joy and walked out to travel the country with his candid friend Declan, leaving his impoverished past behind.   Back at the Vance household, the truth unraveled quickly. Alistair proved to be incompetent and heavily indebted, botching major household tasks, alienating top business clients who only trusted Ronan, and bringing debt collectors to the company's doorsteps. A hidden company file left by Ronan revealed that he was the mastermind behind over sixty percent of the corporation’s key partnerships, leaving Seraphina and her family stricken with guilt as they finally realized who had truly kept them afloat. When Seraphina tracked Ronan down to a humble noodle stall to apologize, he firmly dismissed the past, regarding her as nothing more than a stranger. Alistair's desperate bid to forge signatures for a twenty-million bank loan led directly to his arrest at a board meeting. Rejecting frantic texts and unspoken regrets from the Vance family, Ronan boards a spur-of-the-moment flight to Bangkok as his bank balance surges even higher, ready to embrace the unpredictable open skies of genuine freedom.

title: How A "Greedy Opportunist" Bore The Weight Of Two Dynasties! - Hein Recap
description:
Name: How A "Greedy Opportunist" Bore The Weight Of Two Dynasties!

--Summary--
Kaelen is notoriously painted as a heartless, money-driven opportunist who took money from Seraphina’s tyrannical mother to abandon their relationship, yet the hidden truth was that Lady Vesper had weaponized his dying father's medical treatment to tear them apart. Despite his sacrifice, Kaelen’s father took his own life to spare the family further suffering, leaving Kaelen burdened with silent trauma and grief. Three years later, after a painful, humiliating reunion and being exiled from the city by Lady Vesper, Kaelen settles into a quiet life as a volunteer teacher in a remote southern mountain village. His solitude is disrupted when Elara, his devoted friend who has harbored feelings for him for years, tracks him down. She brings urgent news: Kaelen’s mother is suffering from severe heart failure and requires immediate city treatment. More shockingly, she reveals that Seraphina had systematically destroyed her mother's corporate empire as an act of vengeance on Kaelen's behalf, an act that ultimately left her critically stabbed and comatose in the hospital. Returning to the city, Kaelen finds a hollow, suicidal Seraphina waking up to absolute despair. title: The Novel-Addicted Assistant - Hein Recap
description:
Name: The Novel-Addicted Assistant

--Summary--
Florian, an overly delicate young man lacking competence, lands a role as assistant to CEO Cressida purely through an academic connection. Heavily influenced by cheesy romance novel tropes, he continuously plays the fragile, submissive victim and stages clumsy romantic advances to win over his female boss. Unbeknownst to him, Cressida and her husband, VP Thorne, are deeply rational, experienced corporate leaders bound by lifelong roots as childhood sweethearts with equal family backgrounds. Instead of being swayed, the couple immediately sees through Florian's schemes—ranging from faked illnesses and attempts to exploit food allergies, to demanding a fake marriage and spreading workplace gossip—quietly collecting undeniable evidence every step of the way. The breaking point arrives when Florian stages an ambiguous photo with lipstick marks beside an intoxicated Cressida and texts it to Thorne to sow discord. The following morning, Cressida exposes the hotel surveillance footage to the entire company and fires him on the spot. When Florian tries to play the victim on social media, the couple promptly uploads comprehensive video proof and sends formal legal warnings, forcing him into a humiliated public apology and industry-wide blacklisting. As life returns to its calm and playful rhythm for the power couple, the narrative leaves an open reflection on the consequences of substituting shallow novel fantasies for genuine character, competence, and reality.

title: Unsent Letters At The Grave - Hein Recap
description:
Name: Unsent Letters At The Grave

--Summary--
Following the loss of his mother, an impoverished young man named Kael rescued and took in Seraphina, a blind girl he found stranded in a dark alley. They shared two intimate years supporting one another in a run-down apartment. However, after witnessing a brief encounter between her and her wealthy fiancé Sterling Thorne, Kael mistakenly believed she was faking her condition and playing with his feelings. Burdened by an inferiority complex, he accepted hush money from Sterling, forged a death certificate, and vanished completely. Five years later, Kael rebuilt his life as a rising singer under his mother's maiden name, only to cross paths again with Seraphina—now fully revealed as the powerful heiress to the Vance conglomerate. Despite his frantic attempts to act as a stranger, Seraphina recognized his familiar habits, voice, and the lingering bond with their old stray dog. Resolute in pursuing him, she publicly shattered her faux engagement, turned her high-society wedding into a live proposal to Kael, and relentlessly supported his career despite his initial rejection. The turning point arrived when Seraphina shielded Kael from an oncoming car, prompting him to visit his rural hometown where he discovered a stack of unsent letters and learned she had loyally tended his mother's grave and waited for him for years. It turned out her past secrecy was merely a desperate move to protect him from a brutal corporate succession war. Confronting the mutual misunderstandings of their past, Kael finally laid down his defenses, paving the way for a heartfelt reunion where they could finally love and protect each other as equals.

Vowing never to grant him the divorce he desires, she genuinely accepts him into her heart, leaving the door wide open to their tangled future, upcoming retaliations against their enemies, and a chaotic tug-of-war between an escapist husband and a possessive CEO.

title: I Let The Nation Extract My Memories - Hein Recap
description:
Name: I Let The Nation Extract My Memories

--Summary--
The narrative unfolds in the year 2028, where twenty-year-old Kaelen, universally reviled by society and his own family as the supposed scumbag who ruined the Vanderbilt household, volunteers to undergo a nationwide live broadcast of visual memory extraction despite excruciating physical agony. As his past is peeled back frame by frame, his three sisters—Seraphina, Isolde, and Cassia—alongside their father Balthazar, are confronted with devastating truths that overturn their deepest convictions. At four years old, Kaelen never selfishly pushed Seraphina aside to flee their kidnapping as she had bitterly believed for sixteen years; instead, the young boy intentionally sprinted toward the abductor to draw him away from her, exhausting himself and kneeling amid moving traffic to plead for help. It also emerges that Isolde was the kidnapper's original target, and Kaelen was seized only because of a feather accessory she had spitefully placed on him. Trapped in the clutches of ruthless human traffickers Griselda and Cletus, Kaelen endured years of severe beatings, starvation, and confinement in a filth-ridden shed. Despite his torment, he braved thorn bushes to gather medicinal herbs and dragged an unconscious Cassia and Genevieve to a mountain cave to treat their fevers. However, Sterling—the family’s favored son—viciously kicked Kaelen down a steep cliff to eliminate him as a rival heir, concealed the cave entrance, and lied to the search party to steal the credit for saving the girls.   
Kaelen’s selflessness continued when he orchestrated the escape of his fellow captive, Lorcan, by deliberately misdirecting the traffickers toward the opposite path, yet Lorcan tragically mistook his actions for betrayal and cruelly rejected him when Kaelen sought him out nine years later. His harrowing journey took an even darker turn when traffickers sold him off as lab rat Subject 0029, leaving him confined inside a mirrored chamber and subjected to unspeakable trauma. Even upon reaching safety at a police station, Kaelen fell into the manipulative grasp of his stepmother Prudence and Sterling, who forced dark makeup onto him, falsely told him his birth mother was dead, and framed him as a petty egg thief to alienate his father, who subsequently relegated him to a squalid servant’s quarters. In the studio, Seraphina is consumed by profound remorse, Lorcan breaks down in inconsolable guilt, and the sisters' blind faith in Sterling begins to fracture. Yet, just as Balthazar furiously prepares to type a comment publicly condemning his biological son, an abrupt and shocking memory flashes onto the screen, leaving him entirely paralyzed as the full, unresolved extent of Kaelen's sacrifices hangs precariously in the balance.

Knowing Seraphina’s lingering obsession, Thaddeus creates a fake account posing as Valerian to trick her into decisively demanding a divorce, collecting his agreed severance, and recording video proof of her renouncing the marriage. At Thaddeus and Calliope’s wedding, Seraphina attempts to derail the ceremony upon discovering the deception and seeing the real Valerian return with a wife, but Thaddeus shuts her down with the video evidence and firmly walks away. Even though Seraphina genuinely turns out to be pregnant from their single night and raises the child alone, Thaddeus fulfills only his bare legal duties, choosing instead to focus entirely on building a life with Calliope, who is expecting their own baby, leaving the long-term emotional fallout and future co-parenting dynamic open-ended.

description:
Name: I Turned A Poor Girl Into A Billionaire

--Summary--
Caspian, a professional conqueror bound to a system, built up an impoverished Seraphina into a wealthy tech CEO and completed his mission by marrying her. However, on their one-year anniversary, her first love Thaddeus returns, leading Seraphina to cruelly discard Caspian and demand a divorce. Knowing she had broken her solemn vow, Caspian effortlessly signs the papers and uses his VIP privilege to activate the "Female Lead Deletion Protocol," triggering a seven-day countdown on Seraphina's lifespan. As her health rapidly drains, Caspian severs all financial ties, evicts her greedy parents who subsequently end up in jail for vandalism, and sells intelligence regarding Thaddeus's whereabouts to Thaddeus’s wealthy, estranged wife Vesper, exposing him as a bankrupt gambler who only wanted Seraphina as an ATM. On Seraphina and Thaddeus's rushed wedding day, Seraphina drops dead at the altar just as the countdown finishes. Left tethered to Caspian as an invisible spirit, she watches in agony as Thaddeus abandons her corpse to grovel before Vesper, only to be dragged off by loan sharks. Her torment deepens at the police station, where her materialistic parents show no grief over her death, caring solely about her inheritance until Caspian coerces them into surrendering Seraphina's company shares in exchange for their freedom. Crushed by regret upon realizing Caspian was the only one who truly cared for her, Seraphina begs for mercy, only for Caspian to coldly reveal his true identity as an emotionless taskmaster. He sells her soul to the system for 100 million points, obliterating her existence before stepping through a teleportation portal to begin his next assignment, leaving the endless cycle of his mission-hopping journey wide open.

Name: I Found A Secret Room Of My Photos
 
--Summary--
In his previous life, Thatcher fled an arranged marriage, inadvertently causing Seraphina—a powerful corporate titan battling crippling depression—to end her life and bequeath him her entire fortune. Caspian is trapped in an exhausting relationship with his ambitious girlfriend, Seraphina, who continuously neglects him in favor of her returned first love, Valerian. Valerian constantly uses subtle, manipulative tactics under the guise of helplessness to draw Seraphina away, culminating in her abandoning Caspian on his birthday dinner to attend to Valerian's minor illness. That very evening, Caspian is contacted by Elara, a strikingly beautiful childhood neighbor who has returned from abroad. When Elara claims to be sick and alone, Caspian rushes her to the emergency room, only to run directly into Seraphina and Valerian.  
At the hospital, the dynamic flips: Elara masters the art of playing the sweet, innocent victim—effectively countering Valerian's antics and leaving Seraphina frustrated by her own hypocrisy. Disillusioned by Seraphina’s double standards, Caspian officially ends the relationship. Seraphina soon realizes what she lost and desperately attempts to win him back, but her apologies fall on deaf ears as Caspian finds genuine warmth, lavish devotion, and fierce loyalty in Elara—who turns out to be an heiress of a massive corporate conglomerate.  
Following an explosive confrontation at a charity gala, Seraphina and Valerian's relationship unravels in scandal and ruin. Meanwhile, Caspian decides to start dating Elara, gradually experiencing what an emotionally secure and drama-free partnership feels like. Unlike Seraphina, Elara aggressively shuts down outside suitors and showers Caspian with adoration. However, Elara's sweet demeanor masks an intense, obsessive possessiveness—from recklessly smashing half-million-dollar watches to emotional extremes. When Elara proposes a year later, Caspian accepts, willingly surrendering to her irresistible charms despite knowing full well the extent of her obsessive, calculating nature.

description:
Name: Leaving The Traitorous Family To Despair!

--Summary--
The story follows Caspian, who endures severe betrayal and emotional neglect from his sister Seraphina and childhood sweetheart Lorelei as they constantly favor Jules, the son of the mistress who ruined his family. Pushed to the brink when the two women give away his late mother's precious keepsakes and miss her memorial service to be with Jules, Caspian burns down the memory-filled family villa, stages his own death, and relocates abroad to start a quiet new life under the name Felix Thorne. Believing him dead, Seraphina and Lorelei are consumed by overwhelming regret, turning their vengeance onto Jules and his mother by stripping them of everything. Nearly two years later, a business trip forces a reunion where both women desperately beg for Caspian's forgiveness—even after Lorelei is severely injured in a retaliatory attack by Jules. Instead of seeking revenge or letting rage linger, Caspian remains entirely indifferent, choosing to move forward with his flourishing design career. After paying his final respects at his mother's grave and drawing a firm boundary never to cross paths again, he embarks on an open-ended future, leaving behind a haunting void of remorse for the two women and stepping freely toward whatever lies ahead.

--Summary--
Caspian, a wealthy heir who once passionately pursued and married the proud, aloof Seraphina, gradually falls out of love with her in their fourth year of marriage. The turning point accelerates when Lysander, Seraphina's former classmate and first love, re-enters her life after a messy divorce. Under the guise of helping an old friend, Seraphina blurs marital boundaries, leaving Caspian emotionally drained and physically detached. The tipping point occurs when Lysander’s dog destroys a precious yarn cat handmade by Caspian’s late mother; Seraphina’s dismissive reaction and Lysander's intrusion shatter whatever affection Caspian had left. Though Seraphina attempts to placate him and downplay her emotional straying, Caspian strategically orchestrates a trip to Yunnan to catch her and Lysander crossing the line. Returning unexpectedly to find them together, Caspian secures an immediate, clean divorce protected by prenuptial terms. Seraphina subsequently spirals into bankruptcy, alienation, and deep regret as she realizes too late that Caspian’s devoted love was what elevated her life in the first place. While Caspian effortlessly reclaims his joy and freedom at his gallery, a penniless Seraphina boards a train back to her impoverished hometown, left with the lingering weight of her choices and the quiet uncertainty of whether she will ever find peace from the loss of the brightest light she once held.

Name: My Wife Demanded A Predatory Divorce

--Summary--
The story follows Rocco Thorne, a ruthless underworld kingpin who transmigrates into the body of Caspian Vance, an oppressed and spineless live-in son-in-law. Waking up in a VIP lounge, he is immediately coerced by his haughty wife, Seraphina Sterling, and her returning lover, Julian Croft, to sign a predatory divorce agreement forfeiting all assets while kneeling for a meager fifty thousand dollars. Shattering their expectations, Caspian unleashes ferocious violence by breaking Julian’s finger, smashing a wine bottle over Seraphina’s head, and calling the police himself under the guise of self-defense while securing crucial video evidence and uncovering a drugged glass of wine. As Seraphina’s influential brother, Alaric Sterling, steps in with corporate retaliation and hired killers, Caspian turns the tables through strategic exposure and brute force. Along with his opportunistic cousin Silas, Caspian uncovers the darker truth behind his father’s fatal car crash, exposing it as an internal purge by the Vance clan's patriarch to cover up massive corporate fraud. Surviving a deadly dockside ambush, Caspian methodically brings both dynasties to their knees: Julian is crippled and disowned, Alaric faces severe imprisonment, Patriarch Vance is stripped of power before law enforcement, and Seraphina is left begging in tears on the pavement as she signs an unconditional divorce. Turning his back on past grievances and blocking Seraphina's desperate pleas, Caspian looks out over the glittering city skyline, fully prepared to build his own venture and carve out a path where he will never kneel to anyone again.

description:

--Summary--
The story follows the four-year relationship between Caspian, a profoundly talented yet discreet music arranger living in a modest 40-square-meter studio, and Lyra, his college sweetheart who has risen to become a reigning pop diva. Despite her long-standing promise to reveal him to the world once famous, overwhelming pressure and manipulation from her manager, Vance, lead Lyra to treat Caspian like a stranger at her fan meet-and-greet, politely asking where he wants her signature. Deeply hurt by this denial, Caspian tears the signed photo in half and walks away. Overcome with regret, Lyra defies her agency and immediately posts a public confession exposing their relationship, igniting an internet firestorm.   
At first, netizens viciously mock Caspian as an unworthy moocher, but the narrative turns upside down when major industry figures, including top singer Rowan, and music analysts reveal his true stature. The public discovers that Caspian is actually the revered "Teacher Cas"—the invisible mastermind whose foundational arrangements shaped Lyra's signature musical identity and earned her two Golden Melody Awards.   
After firing her manager and facing career retaliation from her label, Lyra visits Caspian's rundown apartment with her self-written song, Return, seeking forgiveness. Caspian stays up all night to refine and arrange the track for her. At the National Music Gala before 18,000 people, Lyra delivers a raw, tearful performance of the song and openly confesses her past cowardice and Caspian's immense sacrifices. Caspian steps onto the stage, fiercely silences the prying world, and takes her hand. The story concludes on an open, tender note: back in the quiet, dim studio where it all began, their fingers interlock as they sit side by side to tweak the music, ready to navigate the tumultuous industry together with rekindled devotion and mutual understanding.

Name: Raised A Villainess: She Went Mad!

--Summary--
After dying in the real world, Caspian transmigrates into a novel tasked by a mysterious System with raising and protecting Seraphina, the story's young and impoverished future villainess. Over twelve years of heartfelt care, Caspian helps the neglected girl transform into a brilliant, capable businesswoman, becoming her gentlest anchor and melting away her inner bitterness. Unbeknownst to him, Seraphina is a reincarnator from a tragic past life where she was betrayed and driven to suicide during a fierce corporate battle against the aristocratic Yang family and her destined rival, Balthazar. Having found salvation in Caspian's love, she develops a profound, possessive attachment to him. However, prolonging his stay in her world costs Caspian his vitality, triggering rapid aging. Concealing the truth to spare her heartbreak, he quietly returns to their old hometown, ultimately taking his final breath in her arms while urging her to break free from despair and live as a free butterfly.   
Devastated by his death, Seraphina channels her grief into a relentless campaign to dismantle the elite families of Radiant Capital. This defiance disrupts the narrative's intended structure, unleashing bizarre phenomena that violently force Balthazar—who in this life simply wants to run his coffee shops—into becoming the unwilling leader of the families against Seraphina. --Summary--
In a desperate bid to reconcile with his estranged daughters, billionaire Sterling Vanderbilt hires Kaelen, an impoverished orphan blessed with otherworldly good looks and emotional intelligence, to pose as their long-lost brother of eighteen years. Utilizing his gentle demeanor and masterclass playing of vulnerability, Kaelen effortlessly melts the defenses of the aloof chaebol heiresses and begins mending the dysfunctional family. The notoriously man-hating Seraphina drops her cold exterior, pampers him, and agrees to return home. Valeria, the chaotic celebrity sister, schemes to expose him through alcohol, only to be overwhelmed by guilt and intense affection when he innocently covers for her. Meanwhile, Aurelia, the powerhouse CEO eldest sister, poses as his girlfriend to ease his sick grandfather’s worries, has him crossdress to save a multi-million-dollar Hanfu livestream—turning him into an overnight viral sensation—and shockingly attempts to hand him control of the entire corporate conglomerate. Even Elara, the severely agoraphobic manga artist, conquers her social anxiety through him, taking him on couple-style dates under the guise of story research and secretly archiving their intimate moments. As Sterling looks on in mounting dread while his daughters' doting sisterly bonds subtly mutate into romantic, possessive infatuation, Kaelen navigates this lucrative yet high-stakes acting gig, leaving open the question of how long this counterfeit identity can survive the escalating web of chaotic affections.

title: I Rejected A Billionaire's Proposal - Jinwoo Recap
description:
Name: I Rejected A Billionaire's Proposal

--Summary--
The story follows Thorne, an attorney struggling with early-onset Alzheimer's disease while mourning the supposed death of his long-time girlfriend, Valeria. While in Kingsport, he encounters the formidable Valeria Vance, a high-society tycoon who bears the exact same name, features, and identifying mole as his lost love. Despite stern warnings from his friend Elowen about the insurmountable class divide, Thorne discovers that the Vance family had previously faked Valeria's death via a staged car accident to force her back into her aristocratic obligations and a transactional engagement with Caspian Sterling. Devastated, Thorne flees abroad to New York, particularly after Elowen tragically dies in a winter incident. As his neurological condition progressively wipes out his past, Valeria suddenly arrives in New York, having formally abandoned her conglomerate and family prestige to live as an ordinary lawyer by Thorne's side. The reunion rekindles Thorne's lost memories through unsent messages, but reality soon catches up when Valeria’s mother intervenes with ruthless ultimata. Aware that resisting her family's immense power will eventually destroy them both, Thorne heartbreakingly rejects Valeria's surprise marriage proposal during a fireworks display at Disneyland. Valeria returns to Kingsport, where her planned marriage falls apart after Caspian takes his own life to reunite in death with Elowen. Months later, Thorne is left to raise their daughter, Aveline, while fighting his slipping cognitive faculties. Nine years after their parting, Valeria secretly watches them on the street, leaving a familiar pair of plush keychains with their child. As Thorne spots the keepsake and looks back into the bustling crowd, she has already vanished, leaving their enduring yet fragmented bond forever open to the echoes of what could have been.

He immediately cashes out a multi-million-dollar mansion registered in his name and slips away to start over. While Seraphina takes on a fake identity as "Penny" and works in a quiet café in the remote mountain town of Whispering Pines, Crispin tracks her down under the alias "Felix". Acting as strangers, the two engage in a playful yet tense dynamic of shared secrets, plumbing emergencies, and an accidental town cooking championship, gradually peeling back each other’s defenses.   
Their rustic hideaway collapses when Archibald corners them with private investigators, a lawsuit, and a staged mistress scheme in an attempt to drag Seraphina into a forced corporate alliance with the Thorne family. Crispin retaliates with a multi-layered trap, deploying evidence of Archibald’s massive financial fraud with the discreet cooperation of Seraphina's mother and his friend Barnaby. As Archibald’s empire implodes within 72 hours, Crispin reveals his true backstory: his father had been ruined by Archibald decades prior, yet Crispin’s pursuit of Seraphina transformed from vengeance into genuine love dating back to a university encounter. Escaping back to Metroburg, the two finally reunite on their own terms at a joyful, intimate wedding before building a peaceful family life in Singapore, leaving behind their past web of family manipulation and corporate schemes.

description:
Name: The Arrogant Blind CEO Who Discarded Her True Savior!

--Summary--
The story begins when Seraphina, a wealthy CEO, regains her eyesight thanks to her husband Finnian risking his life to test experimental treatments, only to immediately demand a divorce so she can reunite with her returning first love, Alistair. Finnian accepts with calm detachment; their three-year marriage was strictly a business arrangement to save his adoptive parents' bankrupt family business, and secretly, he had been using Seraphina as an emotional stand-in for his vanished high school first love, Elowen, who looks virtually identical to Seraphina. The tension escalates when Seraphina discovers a preserved photograph of Finnian and Elowen, misinterprets it as a perverted composite photo using her own face, and furiously kicks him out of the villa. However, once she learns the photo is an authentic picture from high school, doubt and jealousy begin to consume her.   
Now separated, Finnian reconnects with his estranged piano mentor, Professor Cassiopeia Vance, to restart his abandoned musical career. Seeing Finnian step back into his own life, and noticing the attention he attracts from Cassiopeia and her friend Beatrix, Seraphina finds herself unable to let him go. She struggles between her nostalgic longing for Alistair—who is growing increasingly entitled, deceitful, and manipulative—and her deep subconscious dependence on Finnian's gentle care. After discovering that Seraphina scapegoated him to Alistair for the divorce delays, Finnian firmly cuts ties and finalizes their official divorce at the Civil Affairs Bureau. Shortly after, fate intervenes: Finnian unexpectedly reunites with Elowen at the train station, learning she has returned after years of medical treatment abroad, and astonishingly, the apartment he recently rented belongs to Elowen's family. As Finnian and Elowen rekindle their profound musical and emotional bond, Seraphina is left spiraling into regret, neglected by an increasingly self-serving Alistair and unable to bear Finnian's total departure. The narrative leaves open what will happen when the stand-in secret inevitably surfaces, how far Alistair will go to manipulate the Seraphina family, and whether Seraphina will come to realize the depth of what she truly threw away as Finnian moves forward into a world where his genuine muse has finally returned.

After losing his cultivation and perishing, Orthodox Dao Paragon Elion is reborn as a frail, tender youth cursed with maxed-out demonic charm. When the ruthless eldest disciple Kaelith descends as an icy avatar to purge the manor, Elion instinctively shields his younger disciples, sparking familiar soul resonances that shake Kaelith's frozen heart before she vanishes to investigate the boy in secret. A chaotic, hazy night ensues where Elion's lost control becomes a battleground of illicit intimacy and manipulation between Lyraell and Ignatia, both plotting to monopolize their master while hiding his return from Kaelith. As Elion struggles to mend his disciples' twisted Dao hearts and uncover who betrayed him, a masked emissary from the Divine Envoys arrives in secret to offer Lyraell the Corrupted Immortal Power, leaving their fate suspended on the brink of an even darker conspiracy.

title: I Have A Gossip System - Jinwoo Recap
description:
Name: I Have A Gossip System

--Summary--
Sterling Vance is on the verge of divorcing his cold CEO wife, Seraphina Vance, when he suddenly awakens a "Gossip-Eating System". The system uncovers high-society secrets and corporate plots, but with a major unintended glitch: Seraphina—and later the entire Vance family—can hear his chaotic internal monologues. Using Sterling’s accidental mental disclosures, Seraphina quickly unmasks her trusted secretary Lysander as a corporate traitor trying to frame Sterling, tearing down his scheme and shutting down the divorce entirely. As Sterling’s mental roasts and secret exposés continue to derail everyday life, Seraphina and her parents begin quietly acting on his thoughts while rewarding him financially, completely altering his standing in the household. The family rallies around this invisible information stream to expose Gideon Graves, the manipulative husband of eldest daughter Evangeline, revealing that Gideon faked their baby's death and passed off their own biological son, Orion, as his illegitimate child with a mistress. With Gideon brought to justice and Orion returned to Evangeline, the narrative shifts to an elite banquet where Seraphina's celebrity brother, Thatcher, plans to break his engagement with the neglected elder twin Ariadne Astor to marry her manipulative sister Lorelei. Through Sterling's system, the Vance family realizes Lorelei and her parents fabricated the story of saving Thatcher's life as a child, completely stealing the heroic rescue actually performed by Ariadne. As Thatcher grapples with the devastating realization of his misplaced loyalty, the banquet descends into sudden chaos when the degenerate Barnaby bursts in to forcibly claim Ariadne, leaving the truth teetering on the edge of public revelation, Thatcher trapped in remorse, and Sterling's inner voice poised to trigger the next explosion.

title: My Wife Skipped Our Son's Funeral For Her Ex - Jinwoo Recap
description:
Name: My Wife Skipped Our Son's Funeral For Her Ex
 
--Summary--
Caspian lived an agonizing, unrequited life married to Seraphina, an heiress who despised him and believed he had schemed to trap her into marriage. Over five years, Seraphina treated Caspian with cold indifference and viewed their young son, Orion, as a badge of shame, all while openly favoring her childhood companion, Lysander. When five-year-old Orion tragically died in a car accident, Seraphina was away in the snowy mountains of Xili with Lysander. She missed her son's final moments and funeral, completely unreachable.  
Orion's death extinguished Caspian’s final reason to endure. Harboring late-stage stomach cancer that he kept secret from Seraphina, he finalized his departure from the Sterling family. Supported only by his former classmate Dr. Elowen, Caspian chose to forgo aggressive treatment and spend his remaining days quietly completing Orion's unfulfilled wishes, including visiting the beach and seeking Orion's lost kitten. As Caspian slipped further toward death, Seraphina slowly realized the gravity of his absence and the terrifying reality of his illness. However, Caspian’s heart had long turned to ash, and he peacefully succumbed to his terminal cancer in the falling snow of Christmas night, yearning only to reunite with his son.  
Following his death, Seraphina spirals into profound despair, cast out by her father and confronted by Elowen. She discovers Caspian's old phone filled with diary memos documenting his silent devotion, quiet heartbreak, and relentless pain. She also learns the truth behind Lysander's manipulations, which had led her to mistakenly believe Caspian loved Elowen and despised her. Consumed by sleeplessness, hypnosis, and hallucinations, Seraphina becomes a walking shadow tormented by regret. Standing on a pedestrian crosswalk, she glimpses a fleeting vision of Caspian and Orion walking away together. Stepping out as a speeding car rushes toward her, Seraphina lets the impact come, left in suspended ambiguity as to whether she will finally face consequences or reunite with the family she spent a lifetime pushing away.

--Summary--
To resurrect his deceased girlfriend, Elara, Kaelen travels to another world bound to a system requiring him to fulfill 100 unconditional tasks for an heiress named Seraphina. Over five years, he endures her icy demeanor and cruel mistreatment, as she remains blindly devoted to her manipulative childhood friend, Lorcan. For the final task, Kaelen willingly agrees to donate his heart to Lorcan to finalize his mission, leaving behind an audio recording that exposes Lorcan's schemes and deceit. Following the fatal surgery, Kaelen detaches from that world, leaving Seraphina overwhelmed by devastating grief and guilt as she belatedly realizes Lorcan's treachery and her own deep love for Kaelen.  
Back in his original world, Kaelen successfully revives Elara, only to find that she has lost all memories of their shared past. Meanwhile, a suicidal Seraphina is bound to a new system that sends her to Kaelen’s world with a three-month conquest mission to win his love, risking all her wealth if she fails. Despite her desperate attempts to make amends, Kaelen remains emotionally detached, eventually confessing that his past devotion was entirely transactional to save Elara. After shielding Kaelen from a falling tree, Seraphina finally accepts reality and requests three final days together before her departure. On the last day, Elara suddenly regains her memories and reclaims Kaelen. Watching them embrace, Seraphina accepts the failure of her mission and fades away to return to her original world, stripped of her fortune. The story concludes on an open note: while Kaelen and Elara walk forward together into their restored love, Seraphina faces an uncertain, impoverished future in her own realm, having ultimately discovered the painful, selfless meaning of letting go.

title: I Just Want To Be A Background NPC - Jinwoo Recap
description:
Name: I Just Want To Be A Background NPC

--Summary--
Caspian, the son of a Sect Leader, enters the Azure Crest Sect determined to survive as an insignificant background NPC, unaware that the central heroines can hear his inner monologues. When peak masters try to pass off the supposedly untalented youth, Caspian mentally disparages the female leads—such as the fiery Senior Sister Seraphina and the Fifth Elder Celestia—and mocks their tragic fates of falling victim to the protagonist Orion's schemes. Overhearing his foreknowledge, Celestia deliberately accepts him into Misty Cloud Peak to keep him close and punish his insolence. Armed with an omniscient system and future plot insights, Caspian continuously disrupts the original narrative while trying to preserve his life. He unwittingly triggers Celestia's curiosity and retaliation, prompts Seraphina to harbor deep suspicion toward Orion, and even intercepts celestial treasures intended for the main character.  
During a dangerous expedition to the Extinct Kingdom Secret Realm, Caspian’s mental predictions alert Celestia to surrounding traps and Orion's self-serving nature, prompting her to safeguard herself and subtly test her disciples. Afterwards, in an opportunistic attempt to seize cultivation resources, Caspian blackmails a seemingly weakened Celestia—unaware that she is merely feigning vulnerability to play along with his schemes. Their journey eventually leads to Aurum Steed City on a sect assignment, where Caspian derails the plot entirely. He subdues the demonic young master Vesper by branding her with a Beast Seal, rescues an ambushed Seraphina from the City Lord's Manor, and exposes Orion’s sinister use of aphrodisiacs intended to entrap her. Forced to act as an anonymous remedy to save Seraphina's life, Caspian flees while leaving behind coins that comically mirror the cost of a courtesan. As Seraphina vows revenge for his absurd insolence, Celestia plots stricter discipline, and Vesper hunts him down with newfound fixation, Caspian finds himself heavily entangled with the very heroines he sought to avoid, leaving the fate of his quiet survival completely thrown into chaos.

title: NOO, My Bride Arrested My Dad At The Altar! - Jinwoo Recap
description:
Name: NOO, My Bride Arrested My Dad At The Altar!

--Summary--
The narrative chronicles the tragic entanglement between Caspian and Vesper, an undercover anti-narcotics detective. Right at their wedding altar, Vesper abruptly arrests Caspian’s father, Thaddeus, unmasking him as the elusive drug lord "S" and shattering the illusion of their three-year romance, reducing it to a calculated sting operation. Stricken with grief following his father’s downfall and execution, Caspian uncovers the devastating truth that his late mother had in fact been an undercover police officer who sacrificed her life in the shadows. Haunted by the need to atone for his father's sins, Caspian cuts all ties and vanishes, while Vesper relies on her partner Lorcan to maintain an emotional wall, pretending they are engaged to push him away for good.  
Three years later, their paths cross again during an operation targeting a ruthless drug syndicate led by Nyx in Willow Township. Undercover once more, Vesper is shocked to find Caspian working as a degraded host and presumed addict inside the syndicate’s nightclub. In reality, Caspian has been operating as the department’s deep-cover informant, "Yellow River," risking everything to bring down the cartel from within. When his cover is ultimately blown, Nyx subjects him to horrific torture. Vesper tracks them down to an abandoned safehouse, where Nyx takes Caspian hostage and demands that Vesper disable herself. To protect Vesper and end the nightmare, Caspian lunges onto Nyx's blade, creating the opening for Vesper to neutralize the kingpin. In his dying breaths, Vesper tearfully confesses her enduring love and the web of lies she spun to keep him away, leaving the syndicate dismantled and Vesper forever bound to an agonizing, irreversible grief.

description:
Name: Zero Tolerance For Drama

--Summary--
After being brought back to the wealthy Vance family, Lorcan breaks his initial silence at a major family banquet by publicly exposing the dark biological background of Caspian, the cherished foster son. When relatives attempt to suppress him, Lorcan responds with fierce physical and verbal defiance, refusing to conform to aristocratic hierarchies and driving both the matriarch, Dowager Constance, and Caspian into distress. Rather than begging for validation, he remains utterly detached, confronting family head Percival and elder sister Ariadne on equal terms. His fierce refusal to back down forces his biological mother, Seraphina, to take his side, culminating in her demanding a separation and moving with Lorcan into a neighboring villa. Caspian attempts to regain sympathy through a deliberate self-victimization scheme, enduring extreme heat outside the villa until he collapses; however, Lorcan remains completely indifferent to the act, which ultimately exposes the hypocrisies within the family. Percival visits Lorcan’s former orphanage, uncovering Lorcan’s troubled, artistic past as well as the dark institutional abuses he survived, while Lorcan gradually learns about the suppressed struggles of his siblings, such as Declan’s strained romance sabotaged by Caspian. As hidden secrets begin to surface and the delicate power dynamics of the household crumble, Lorcan’s arrival fundamentally alters the Vance family's status quo, leaving open the question of whether he will dismantle the household or forge an unconventional path of his own.

title: How The Betrayed Husband Become A Global Star! - Jinwoo Recap
description:
Name: How The Betrayed Husband Become A Global Star!

--Summary--
Lysander Thorne, deeply traumatized by a one-sided marriage where his wife, Vespera Sterling, manipulated him into donating a kidney to save her first love—who happens to be his estranged younger brother, Cassian—seeks out a master hypnotherapist to erase every memory of his painful past. Exhausted by years of being treated as an expendable substitute, Lysander rejects the empty status of being "Mr. Sterling" and demands a divorce. When Vespera decides to send him abroad to keep Cassian emotionally stable, Lysander seizes the opportunity to escape entirely, discarding every cent and luxury item tied to the Sterling family before secretly rerouting his flight to the foreign city of Lumina.  
Battling acute physical collapse and near-fatal post-surgery infections in a strange land, Lysander rescues an enigmatic, wounded runaway girl named Lyra. The two form a fiercely loyal bond, prompting Lysander to rebuild his life around his true calling: fashion design. Through sheer resilience and undeniable craftsmanship, he gains admission to Lumina's premier fashion academy, secures an elite aristocratic clientele, and qualifies for a prestigious global rookie competition under the radar of fashion titan Madame Cressida. Meanwhile, pressured by corporate interests back in Valeria to present a unified front at an annual gala, Vespera travels abroad to fetch him, only to discover he never arrived and might have perished as an unidentified victim in a riot. To protect the Sterling family's enterprise from scandal, her parents orchestrate a malicious PR campaign framing Lysander as an unfaithful deserter while portraying Vespera as a devoted victim. As public outrage mounts against a man who has vanished without a trace, Lysander continues his steady ascent toward the global stage, setting up an inevitable, unresolved collision with the very people who sought to define and discard him.
